instruction:
Three-software CAE flow: AutoCAD -> SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. At the start of the task, use the AutoCAD 2024, SOLIDWORKS 2025, and Abaqus CAE shortcuts on the desktop as the three stages of this workflow. No init files are provided; start from blank files.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_08. In AutoCAD, add a readable label containing EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_08 and AUTOCAD_TO_SOLIDWORKS on a CHAIN layer in stage1_profile.dxf. In SolidWorks, keep EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_08, FROM_stage1_profile.dxf, and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS encoded in the part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage2_geometry.step contains them. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_ACAD_SW_ABQ_08 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage2_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.

1. In AutoCAD, draw a closed 160 x 35 mm strap on OUTLINE. Draw D12 holes on HOLE centered at (15,17.5) and (145,17.5) mm. Draw a centered 55 x 10 mm obround slot on SLOT using 5 mm end radii with arc centers at (57.5,17.5) and (102.5,17.5) mm. Save stage1_profile.dxf.
2. In SolidWorks, import the DXF in millimeters, extrude the strap to 4 mm, cut both D12 holes and the complete obround slot through, keep one solid, and export stage2_geometry.step.
3. In Abaqus/CAE, import the STEP into Model-DxfSlottedStrapTension. Define and assign Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3. Create Static General step Step-Tension, sets LEFT_END, RIGHT_END, and SLOT_EDGE, and a first-order C3D4 or C3D8R mesh with no more than 1000 nodes. Fix LEFT_END with BC-LeftEnd. Couple RIGHT_END with Coupling-RightEnd and apply the unique action Load-RightEnd1000N with CF1=+1000 N. Submit Job-DxfSlottedStrapTension and wait for completion.

4. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_profile.dxf, C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage2_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DxfSlottedStrapTension.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-DxfSlottedStrapTension.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

First use AutoCAD to create the DXF profile, then use SolidWorks to import the DXF and export the STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables. Software launch locations: SOLIDWORKS 2025: `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\SOLIDWORKS 2025.lnk`; Abaqus/CAE: `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Abaqus CAE.lnk`; AutoCAD 2024 (English): `C:\Users\Public\Desktop\AutoCAD 2024 - English.lnk`.
